final: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS n FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY = r.ordervault COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY o.ordertune), mean_count AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS mean_n FROM counts) SELECT AVG(c.n) AS average_count, AVG(c.n - m.mean_n) AS average_excess FROM counts AS c CROSS JOIN mean_count AS m WHERE m.mean_n IS NOT NULL AND c.n > m.mean_n
